family_title_en: Spell rhyming words to answer riddles

stages.ix_title: Spell rhyming words to answer riddles

what_to_do.en: Tap the rhyming word with the right spelling.
what_to_do.ko: 운이 맞고 철자가 바른 단어를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole words from the roots list. Stem frame: It rhymes with [clue]. Then a short kid clue. Exactly one choice is the correct spelling of the word that rhymes with the clue and answers the riddle. The other three are a listed misspelling, a real rhyme that does not fit, or a word that does not rhyme. Higher tiers use closer spellings.

gold_items.stem: It rhymes with log. A pet that barks.
It rhymes with tall. You can kick it.
It rhymes with hat. This pet says meow.
It rhymes with lake. Food with candles on it.
It rhymes with dish. It can swim.
It rhymes with mitten. A baby cat.
It rhymes with kite. Time to sleep for <NAME>.
It rhymes with pool. Kids go there to learn.

roots: Four whole-word choices, and exactly one is the correct spelling of the riddle answer.
The answer must rhyme with the clue and match the kid clue. Only the answer does both.
Build distractors from the roots list: a listed misspelling, a rhyme that does not fit, or a word from another family.
Tier 1 keeps distractors far apart, with at most one broken or scrambled spelling.
Tier 2 uses a real rhyme that misses the meaning, and may add one mild listed misspelling.
Tier 3 uses two near-miss spellings from the list and one rhyme that does not fit.
Stems and choices stay whole words. Do not use a lone sound, a slash, or a letter name.

tier_rules.1: Seven or eight words and a one-syllable answer from home, pets, play, or food. Wrong choices are kid words that do not rhyme, or one broken or scrambled spelling from the word list.
tier_rules.2: Seven to nine words. The answer may have two syllables. Include a real rhyme that does not fit the clue. A mild listed misspelling or a look-alike word may appear too.
tier_rules.3: Up to ten words. Two wrong choices are near-miss spellings from the word list, and one wrong choice rhymes but does not fit. A name token may be used.

rhyme_spell.en: This word rhymes with the clue and is spelled the right way.
rhyme_spell.ko: 이 단어는 단서와 운이 같고 철자가 바릅니다.

fits_clue.en: The right word rhymes with the clue and matches the riddle.
fits_clue.ko: 맞는 단어는 단서와 운이 같고 수수께끼의 뜻에도 맞습니다.

near_spell.en: Watch each letter. The real spelling rhymes and fits the riddle.
near_spell.ko: 글자를 잘 보세요. 운이 맞고 뜻에 맞는 바른 철자입니다.
